Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a short executive intro + product demo (~35 minutes) that includes a VP-level product stakeholder from your side and the CIO if possible. High-level goals for the session:

- Rapid exec-level overview of how Redwood handles inference economics and reliability
- One concrete customer example that maps to your ROI questions from the call
- Time for your CIO to ask architecture/security questions toward procurement

Availability we can offer (all times PT):
- Tue Jun 29, 10:30–11:15
- Wed Jun 30, 15:00–15:45
- Thu Jul 1, 08:00–08:45 (early)

Can you confirm which slot works for your VP and whether the CIO can join? If the CIO prefers a separate, shorter technical briefing, we can schedule that immediately before or after the exec walkthrough.

I'll loop in Priya (account lead) to help coordinate invites and Evelyn (solutions) to lead the demo. Attaching a short one-pager that outlines what we'll cover and a tentative agenda.

Attachments: Neoterra-brief.pdf (1-page summary), redwood-demo-invite.ics (placeholder invite)

2) Offer the CIO (Marco) a 20-minute technical add-on immediately after the meeting (15:40–16:00 PT) in case he can squeeze it in. If he can't, we'll schedule the separate Thu Jul 1 09:00 PT deep-dive as you suggested.
3) Evelyn will run the demo and surface the architecture slides; Priya will own logistics. I'll be present for the first 10 minutes of the exec intro to cover the business benefits and hand off to Evelyn.

Action items:
- Hannah / Tom: confirm if Marco can attempt the 15:40 add-on; if yes we'll include the invite and an optional meeting link for the CIO. If no, confirm Thu Jul 1 09:00 PT for the tech-only session.
- Priya: please send the calendar invites (exec + optional CIO add-on + tech-only fallback).

I've attached the one-pager again and a draft agenda below. Calendar placeholders: redwood-demo-invite.ics. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/4821

Draft agenda (35 min):
- 0–5 min: quick intros & goals (Marcus)
- 5–20 min: demo — customer story + live walkthrough (Evelyn)
- 20–30 min: ROI and deployment/ops overview (Evelyn/Marcus)
- 30–35 min: next steps & procurement checklist (Priya)

Evelyn — can you confirm you're available to lead the demo at 15:00 PT on Jun 30?

Cheers,
Marcus
